prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions underpredicted gains on winning tests while being overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 4 tests.

choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as they lack at least 2 agreeing tests.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Persistence Safety Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that signing in preserves your pet across desktop restarts and updates. (why: Support mail highlights 8 issues where pets were missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in hints won 3 out of 4 previous tests.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Rendering Stage Companion Preview Screen: Inserts a dedicated render preview screen immediately after waiting to show asset compilation progress. (why: The home stage wait conversion drops to 89.4% with a mean duration of 2336s, and adding visual progress screens reduces drop-off during generation.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Interactive Usage Sub-Flow: Adds an interactive checklist component to the home intro screen detailing mouse controls and desktop pet commands. (why: Support received multiple complaints regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop after completing onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Realtime Progress Counter: Enables step counter and completion system notifications on the waiting screen with status body text. (why: home wait_info changes were successful in both prior tests, mitigating user drop-off during long pet rendering times (median 201s).)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance Hint: Displays a direct hint on the photo upload screen outlining lighting and framing suggestions for accurate pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance results during adoption.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop App Auto-Launch System Notification: Adds a hint on the home intro screen notifying users that the pet is running in the system tray. (why: Support logged 3 tickets where pets did not appear on desktop or users thought the app failed to open after finishing.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Flexible Switching Hint: Adds a helpful hint on choose_path assuring users they can pick additional pets or switch paths later. (why: Users take a median of 8s but mean of 514s on path selection, indicating hesitation when choosing their pet route.)
